Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Round Metal Coffee Table, 18.5"H, Gold and Glass
Materials: metal
The high gloss, gold-finish frame rims glass shelves, bringing modern glamour to your room. Use the top for a lamp or displaying photos. The lower glass shelf gives you more display space -- or a place to stash magazines or a gaming console. 18"W x 18"D x 21"H Metal, tempered glass Plenty of gloss and shine for a modern glam look A pretty style piece for your room along with providing display space No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
